Messages.Author: chromeboy
Messages.Body:
I searched the newsgroup for rotschreck+yawp court but could not find
the answer:

So Rotschreck ends combat. Does Yawp court now set up an effect that
interrupts the going-to-torpor part of Rotschreck like psyche does?
Does it mean
A)the blocking minion takes 2 damage and than the acting minion goes
to torpor or does it mean
B)the blocking minion takes 2 damage and the referendum is conducted
as normal with the going to torpor part being cancled
or does it mean
C)I'm an idiot, rotschreck ends combat, the acting minion goes to
torpor and thats it?

Rotschreck:
Master: out-of-turn. <Frenzy.> Put this card on a vampire when an
opposing minion attempts to inflict aggravated damage on him or her,
whether the damage would be successfully inflicted or not. Combat
ends. This vampire is tapped and sent to torpor. This vampire does not
untap as normal. During this vampire's next untap phase, burn this
card.

Yawp Court:
Master: unique location. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire. Tap when a
political action is successful, before the referendum, to have a ready
untapped Sabbat vampire you control tap and enter combat with the
acting vampire. If the acting vampire is still ready at the end of
combat, the Sabbat vampire takes 2 damage, and the referendum is
conducted as normal.

Messages.Author: Thrall of Arika
Messages.Body:


Moot? The acting vampire cannot play Rotschreck on the Yawp Court
vampire.

Even with a 'play on your own turn' Rotschreck, I don't see why a
continuing action would have any further effect on the going to torpor
vampire. Combat ends, the acting vampire would still be ready, so the
Yawp vampire takes 2 damage. Combat is over with, the Yawp vampire
would then goes to torpor, and the referendum continues.

Chris, Thrall of Arika
